title: Iolite

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Iolite is a material used to craft the "Thunder/Storm" version of some Ashlands weapons. They have a chance to be found in Charred chests inside Charred Fortresses located in Ashlands.
A weapon upgraded with Iolite gains 10 lightning damage and has a 25% chance to trigger a Chain Lightning on hit with the normal attack and a 20% chance with the secondary attack, except for the bow. The bow has a 20% chance to trigger with the normal attack.

sections.heading: Crafting
sections.text:
• Nidhögg the Thundering
• Scourging Slayer
• Splitnir the Storming
• Storm Fang
• Storm Ripper
• Storm Star
• Thundering Berserkir axes

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: There is a creature (internal ID "Goblin_Gem") that never appears in the actual game, but can be spawned using the console, that drops all three kinds of Ashlands gemstones.
